log_level.description: Verbosity of ipmiseld logs (0–7). Higher numbers = more verbose.

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging when syslog is enabled.

log_to_syslog.description: If true, logs are sent to syslog. If false, logs go to a file.

log_file.description: Path to the local log file (used only if syslog is disabled).

default_host.description: Default BMC hostname/IP to use when no per-host override is provided.

default_username.description: Default BMC username (optional, often left blank for IPMI 2.0+ with no-auth).

default_password.description: Default BMC password (store securely; consider environment variables or ACL-protected files in production).

default_interface.description: Default BMC communication interface (e.g., lan, lanplus, kmip).

auto_detect.description: If true, ipmiseld will attempt to auto-discover BMCs on the local network.

hosts.description: List of explicitly configured BMCs to monitor. Each entry defines hostname, credentials, and optional overrides.

name.description: Unique identifier for this host entry (e.g., 'bmc1'). Used as prefix in config keys.

username.description: BMC username for this host (overrides default_username).

password.description: BMC password for this host (overrides default_password).

interface.description: BMC interface type for this host (overrides default_interface, optional).

port.description: BMC IPMI UDP port (usually 623; override only if non-standard).

initial_fetch_limit.description: Maximum number of existing SEL entries to fetch from each BMC at startup.

poll_interval.description: Seconds between BMC polling for new SEL entries.

continuous_logging.description: If true, ipmiseld will continuously monitor and log new SEL events.

sel_log_format.description: Format for SEL log output: text, xml, or csv.

sel_log_file.description: Path to the SEL event log file (used only when syslog is disabled and LogFormat=text).
